data.summary_en: We propose multi-round Retrospective Self-Distillation (RSD): same model as student and teacher; cross-task precedents, turn-level reflections, retrospective review as privileged context for policy-action re-estimation; on-policy self-distillation feeds back policy, co-evolving model, data, supervision; on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, SearchQA, RSD improves up to 59.7% over base model.
